article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Vaccination campaigns underway to curb outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is facing a significant measles outbreak, particularly in Cirebon City, where 50 pediatric patients have been hospitalized since January 2026, leading to two fatalities among unvaccinated children. The outbreak was declared an Extraordinary Event on February 20, 2026, affecting all five districts of Cirebon City, with a notable increase in cases since late December 2025. In Central Sulawesi, from January to April 2026, there have been 913 suspected and confirmed cases, although a decline is observed with only 53 suspected cases reported in week 14, attributed to immunization catch-up campaigns and Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) targeting children aged 9–59 months. In Tasikmalaya, 38 children tested positive, prompting a vaccination drive for 6,000 under-fives. Health authorities stress the importance of maintaining Clean Living and Healthy Behavior (PHBS) and ensuring complete vaccinations to control transmission, while hospitals implement strict isolation protocols for measles cases.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹：発生を抑制するためのワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで複数地域にまたがる麻疹の重大な発生があり、入院患者50名、死亡2名を含む。IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と長期曝露の懸念が該当する。
triage.notes: インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれている。記事サマリーに複数地域での発生が明記されており、Cirebon City（西ジャワ）、Central Sulawesi、Tasikmalayaで確認されている。宣言されたExtraordinary Event、死亡例、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中といった情報から、国家レベルでの関心と対応が明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Vaccination and control efforts show promising results
article.articleSummary: As of April 11, 2026, Brazil has reported approximately 227,500 suspected dengue cases, reflecting a significant 75% decrease from 916,400 cases during the same period in 2025. This decline follows a peak of 6.6 million cases in 2024. The Ministry of Health confirmed 469 laboratory cases and noted 3,266 probable cases in Mato Grosso do Sul. Vaccination efforts are ongoing, with 223,322 doses administered, including 147,123 first doses and 88,420 second doses. São Paulo state has reported 28,281 confirmed cases and 12 deaths, with 80% of dengue hotspots located in homes, prompting intensified vector control measures. Over 40,000 health workers are actively monitoring Aedes aegypti foci. Additionally, Rio Grande do Sul confirmed its first dengue death of 2026, involving an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities. Preventive measures focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites and promoting community participation in vector control, with integrated efforts in municipalities like Bonito, where health education and cleanup campaigns are underway.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：ワクチン接種と対策の取り組みが有望な結果を示す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでデング熱の大規模流行が継続中であり、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度（死亡例あり）」「長期曝露（流行継続）」「流行しやすさ（蚊媒介、ヒト-ヒト感染なし）」に複数該当。国内での死亡確認とワクチン対応状況から国際関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2025年同時期の916,400件から227,500件への75%減少が報告されているが、これは2024年の660万件のピークからの継続対応局面を示している。サンパウロ州で28,281件の確定例と12死亡、リオグランデドスル州での2026年初の死亡例（83歳）が確認されており、重症度の懸念は持続している。ワクチン接種プログラムが進行中（223,322回接種）であり、政府対応能力は確認されているが、依然として大規模な流行管理が必要な状態。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Community initiatives and vaccination efforts underway
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, Brazil's Mato Grosso do Sul state is experiencing a significant chikungunya outbreak, with 12 confirmed deaths, representing 63% of the national total of 19 fatalities. Dourados is the epicenter, reporting approximately 4,900 probable cases and 1,710 confirmed cases, with a high positivity rate of 67-79%. Recent fatalities include a 63-year-old man and two infants, with further deaths under investigation. In response, the Ministry of Health has launched a vaccination campaign, distributing 20,000 doses of the IXCHIQ vaccine, primarily targeting health professionals and indigenous communities. Healthcare training programs are being implemented in four municipalities to enhance clinical management and epidemiological monitoring. The outbreak has transitioned from Indigenous community transmission to urban cases, with 111 new urban cases confirmed in just 24 hours, raising the urban total to 1,858. In Sorriso, thousands of confirmed cases have been reported, with urban conditions favoring Aedes aegypti proliferation. The situation highlights urban governance failures, necessitating comprehensive community engagement and innovative strategies to combat mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのチクングニア：コミュニティ主導の取り組みとワクチン接種キャンペーン進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：19人死亡、4,900の推定患者；異常性：大規模流行；国際拡大リスク：都市型感染への移行）。WPRO基準4項目該当（異常な流行、重症度が高い、長期曝露のリスク、流行性の高さ）。社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州Dourados市を中心とした大規模流行。19人の死亡（そのうち12人が当州）、4,900の推定患者、1,710の確定患者を報告。先住民コミュニティから都市部への感染拡大が進行中で、24時間で111件の新規都市部症例が確認された。保健省がIXCHIQワクチン20,000用量を配分し対応中。都市部でのAedes aegypti増殖が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in India: Containment measures and public health precautions implemented
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Bengaluru, Karnataka, particularly at a poultry farm in Hesaraghatta. In response, authorities have culled 7,444 infected birds and disposed of 14,788 eggs. Emergency containment measures include the establishment of a 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone, with restrictions lasting one year. Rapid Response Teams are actively monitoring the situation, conducting door-to-door health screenings in 19 nearby villages, and ensuring that staff are under medical observation. Although no human cases have been reported, public health officials advise residents to avoid contact with sick or dead birds and to report any sightings. The World Health Organization has raised concerns regarding potential human transmission and emphasizes food safety. The outbreak has also led to increased chicken meat prices due to supply constraints, prompting veterinary inspections in local markets for early signs of infection. Authorities assure that properly cooked poultry products remain safe for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: インドの高病原性鳥インフルエンザ：H5N1がベンガルール農場で確認、防止措置と公衆衛生予防措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがインドで確認され、大規模な畜産農場での流行、複数州への地理的拡大、人間への潜在的感染リスク、WHOの懸念表明があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当のため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: H5N1確認農場所在地はベンガルール（カルナタカ州）およびボーパル（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州）。感染鳥7,444羽の殺処分、3km感染地帯と10km監視地帯の設定、19村でのドアツードアスクリーニング実施。人間への感染報告はないが、WHO が人間への感染可能性について懸念を表明し、食品安全を強調。市場での鶏肉価格上昇により経済的影響も確認。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Brazil: Recent outbreak linked to food safety violations
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, a foodborne outbreak in Pombal, Paraíba, Brazil, has resulted in one confirmed death and over 80 suspected cases of food poisoning associated with La Favorita pizzeria. The outbreak, traced to contaminated tomato sauce containing Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus aureus, occurred on March 15-16, prompting 117 individuals to seek medical attention for symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. The deceased, Raíssa Maritein Bezerra, 44, succumbed to an acute severe intestinal infection after consuming pizza from the establishment. Investigations revealed cross-contamination during food handling, while the meat served was found to be uncontaminated. Health authorities have since closed the pizzeria, and owner Marcos Antônio Neto faces 117 charges for selling unsafe food. Prosecutors are considering further legal action due to significant food safety violations identified during the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの大腸菌：食品安全違反に関連した最近の集団発生
triage.triage_reason: 食品由来の集団発生で死亡例1件、疑い例80件以上を確認。IHR基準で「重大な公衆衛生上の影響」と「異常性」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡）、流行の可能性（ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低いが食品媒介性）、管理可能性で複数該当。ブラジルは対象国。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・パライバ州ポンバル市のピッツェリアでの食品由来の集団発生を報告。死亡例あり、複数の違反が確認されている。ただし現時点では国際的な拡大の兆候は報告されていない。食品安全違反に基づく管理措置（店舗閉鎖、法的対応）が進行中であり、管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A in Brazil: Vaccination efforts expand amid rising hospitalizations
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Brazil is facing a notable increase in Influenza A (H3N2) cases, with five fatalities reported this year, including a 17-year-old girl in the Federal District. Hospitalizations have surged, particularly among the elderly and unvaccinated, with Rio Grande do Sul reporting a 160% increase in hospitalizations from 55 to 143 compared to the same period last year. The Brazilian health system (SUS) is intensifying vaccination campaigns targeting vulnerable groups such as seniors, children, pregnant women, and individuals with pre-existing conditions. Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases are also on the rise, with influenza accounting for 32.7% of these cases and 43.7% of related deaths. Although the current vaccine does not specifically target the Gripe K strain, health authorities stress the importance of vaccination to reduce symptom severity. Preventive measures, including hand hygiene and masking, are being promoted as the influenza season begins, with vaccination campaigns running through May 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザA：入院増加の中でワクチン接種努力が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行性、対応可能性）。複数州での急速な入院増加、死亡事例、ワクチン未接種人口への影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 2026年4月時点でのインフルエンザA（H3N2）による複数州での流行拡大。Rio Grande do Sul州では前年同期比160%の入院増加、5名の死亡事例（17歳少女を含む）、SRAG関連死の43.7%がインフルエンザによるもの。ブラジル保健当局による積極的なワクチン接種キャンペーンが展開中。本イベントはフルリスク評価（RRA）に進める優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Brazil: Public health initiatives address ongoing rabies threats
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, Brazil is confronting serious rabies challenges, particularly highlighted by a recent case in Piauí where a 17-year-old boy died from suspected human rabies after being bitten by a squirrel monkey. The patient displayed severe symptoms, leading to his transfer to a specialized treatment facility, with ongoing investigations to confirm the diagnosis. In Sorocaba, the sixth rabies case in bats was reported this year, prompting local health authorities to enhance preventive measures, including home visits and increased vaccination efforts for pets. In Montes Claros, an infected bat was discovered in the Funcionários neighborhood, leading to a mass vaccination campaign for dogs and cats scheduled from April 22 to 24. Residents are encouraged to bring unvaccinated pets to designated sites for vaccination, emphasizing the critical role of public health initiatives in controlling rabies, a disease that continues to pose significant risks to both human and animal populations.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの狂犬病：公衆衛生の取り組みが継続する狂犬病脅威に対処
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数地域での人獣共通感染症の発生、死亡例報告、動物でのウイルス検出により、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のブラジル地域（ピアウイ州、ソロカバ、モンテス・クラロス）での狂犬病事例を報告。17歳少年の死亡、複数のコウモリ陽性例、および動物咬傷による人獣共通感染症の継続的リスク。公衆衛生当局による予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in India: Public health measures implemented to prevent spread
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, an outbreak of H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, prompting immediate public health responses. The outbreak was identified on April 14, leading to the culling of 7,444 birds and the destruction of 14,788 eggs at a poultry farm. Authorities established a 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone, enforcing strict movement restrictions on poultry and related products. Quarantine measures have been implemented for poultry workers, with health teams conducting daily fever surveillance in 19 surrounding villages, monitoring approximately 25,000 residents for flu-like symptoms. Despite the high mortality rate associated with H5N1, no human infections have been reported to date. Public health advisories stress the importance of avoiding contact with sick or dead birds and ensuring proper cooking of poultry. The situation is under close observation as authorities continue to implement biosecurity measures to prevent further spread of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおけるA型鳥インフルエンザH5N1ヒト感染：感染拡大防止のための公衆衛生措置が実施
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の確認事例が報告されており、IHR基準（異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、また重症度の高い病原体であることからWPRO基準複数項目に合致する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは現在までにヒト感染者は報告されていないと明記されているが、H5N1は極めて高い致死率を持つ病原体であり、カルナタカ州ベンガルール市のポultry farmでの確認と公衆衛生対応の規模（約25,000人のサーベイランス対象、3km感染ゾーン、10km監視ゾーン設定）から、シグナルとして認識すべき。今後のヒト感染報告の可能性と地域拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza in India: Containment measures and health advisories in effect
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak has been confirmed at a poultry farm in Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, leading to the culling of 7,444 birds and disposal of 14,788 eggs. Authorities have established a 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone, with health teams conducting door-to-door checks for flu-like symptoms in 19 nearby villages, which collectively house over 25,000 residents. Although no human infections have been reported, public health advisories emphasize the importance of consuming properly cooked poultry and avoiding contact with sick or dead birds. Ten cullers are currently under quarantine and receiving oseltamivir prophylaxis, with medical supplies available at local health centers. The World Health Organization has issued warnings regarding the potential for human transmission, highlighting the necessity for ongoing vigilance and effective containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドでの鳥インフルエンザの人間感染：封じ込め対策と健康勧告が実施中
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザのインド国内での確認は異常・予想外であり、国際的な拡大リスクを有する。WHOの警告、複数州での感染、及び予防的隔離措置により、スクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 大規模養鶏場でのH5N1確認。現在のところ人間感染は報告されていないが、WHOの警告、2州（カルナタカ州、マディヤプラデシュ州）での感染確認、予防的隔離下の10名の従事者、及び25,000人以上の住民への監視対象化により、国際的に重要なシグナル。IHR基準4つ全て、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Health system under pressure from seasonal influenza cases
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, the influenza K (H3N2) virus has been confirmed in the Federal District and Goiás, with a reported death of a 17-year-old girl highlighting the vulnerabilities in the health system. During epidemiological week 14 (April 5–11), the Federal District recorded six confirmed H3N2 cases and 1,627 Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases, with 67 attributed to influenza. Goiás reported three mild cases of influenza K, all of which have resolved. Despite the overall mild influenza season, local healthcare capacity is strained, particularly in Japorã, where case numbers are increasing. Vaccination efforts, which began on March 25, have seen over 100,000 doses administered, achieving 23% coverage among the elderly and 19.5% among pregnant women. Health officials are emphasizing the importance of preventive measures and directing mild cases to Basic Health Units to ensure that healthcare resources are available for more severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ：季節性インフルエンザ事例による保健システムへの圧力
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザK（H3N2）の確認と死亡報告があるが、現時点では季節性インフルエンザの標準的な流行範囲内と評価される。情報不足により、より詳細な評価にはさらなる疫学データが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの流行を報告している。死亡事例1件が報告されているが、全体的には軽症の流行とされている。保健システムの逼迫が局所的に報告されているが、国際的な拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。ワクチン接種が進行中で、公衆衛生対応が進められている。現段階ではシグナルとしてのピックアップには至らないが、死亡事例の詳細情報や疫学動向の続報により判定が変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Q Fever in China: Zoonotic transmission risks highlighted in urban settings
article.articleSummary: In April 2026, a 43-year-old man in Shenzhen was diagnosed with Q fever after experiencing a week of high fever unresponsive to antibiotics. Blood metagenomic sequencing confirmed the presence of Coxiella burnetii, the causative agent of Q fever. The patient had frequent exposure to street beef markets and owned a dog, indicating potential zoonotic transmission routes through livestock and pets. Q fever is primarily transmitted via aerosols or placental material from infected animals, with ticks serving as secondary vectors. Although human-to-human transmission is rare, high-risk groups include veterinarians and slaughterhouse workers. Public health officials recommend regular veterinary checks for pets and caution against environments where ticks may thrive. This case underscores the importance of heightened awareness and preventive measures regarding zoonotic diseases in urban settings, particularly in light of the pet-associated transmission route identified in this incident.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のQ熱：都市環境でのズーノーティック感染リスクが強調される
triage.triage_reason: Q熱の散発的な個別症例報告であり、現時点では異常性や重症度は限定的。ただしズーノーティック感染経路の存在と都市部での潜在的拡大リスクを示唆しており、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であるが、都市環境でのズーノーティック感染（食肉市場、ペット経由）が確認されている点が特徴。散発症例が集団発生に発展する可能性を注視する必要あり。中国の公開情報源からの報告のため信頼性評価が別途必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox in Ghana: Intensified vaccination and monitoring efforts underway
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Ghana has confirmed 1,062 cases of Mpox, with a total of 8 fatalities reported since the outbreak began on May 19, 2025. The Ghana Health Service (GHS) has ramped up vaccination and monitoring efforts, particularly targeting high-risk groups across all 16 regions. The first death linked to Mpox occurred on July 28, 2025, and the virus continues to circulate, prompting the enforcement of public health measures to contain its spread. Recent updates indicate four new cases, but no additional hospital admissions have been recorded, and the death toll remains stable. Transmission occurs through close contact, body fluids, and respiratory droplets, with symptoms including fever, swollen lymph nodes, and a painful rash. Surveillance has been intensified, with over 120 districts reporting cases, particularly in urban centers like Accra. Authorities are promoting hygiene practices, early reporting of suspected cases, and public education campaigns to enhance early detection and responsible behavior to mitigate further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのMpox：ワクチン接種と監視活動の強化が進行中
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの継続的な流行（確定患者1,062例、死亡8例）、複数地域への拡大、ヒト-ヒト感染の危険性、公衆衛生対応実施中により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性が確認される。
triage.notes: ガーナは対象国リストに含まれていないが、Mpoxの継続的流行と公衆衛生対応の実施状況から、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要がある。記事では2025年5月19日から継続中の流行が報告されており、最新の死亡例がない一方で複数地域での広がりが確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Outbreak response and vaccination efforts underway
article.articleSummary: In Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, a rabies outbreak has been confirmed following a dog bite incident on April 14, 2026, where a golden-coated dog attacked four individuals in Sơn Tịnh Commune. The dog was captured and euthanized, with subsequent testing revealing the rabies virus on April 17. Local authorities have established an outbreak zone and are intensifying surveillance of bite cases. They are also promoting post-exposure vaccinations for the victims and launching vaccination campaigns for local pets. The Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine is conducting surveys of the dog and cat population, urging residents to confine and vaccinate their pets to prevent further transmission. Public-awareness initiatives are emphasizing responsible pet management, particularly during hot weather, to mitigate the risk of future rabies incidents.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける狂犬病：発生対応とワクチン接種活動が進行中
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンガイ省での狂犬病確認事例だが、現時点では限定的な規模（犬1頭、被害者4人）であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当せず。ただしヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いものの、動物から人への感染が確認されており、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 限定的なアウトブレーク事例として報告されているが、狂犬病は一度確定すると高い致死率を有し、適切な対応が必要。ベトナムは狂犬病の風土病地域であり、地域当局による予防接種キャンペーンと動物管理強化が進行中。国際支援の必要性は現在ない。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: High transmission rates and severe complications reported
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is currently facing a significant outbreak of Enterovirus 71 (EV71), with household transmission rates reaching approximately 60%. A recent case involved a 13-month-old girl who suffered severe complications from hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD), including bronchitis and neurological symptoms. Medical professionals caution that EV71 can lead to rapid deterioration, resulting in severe neurologic illness and cardiopulmonary failure. Symptoms to monitor include high fever, vomiting, seizures, and altered consciousness, particularly in children under six, who are most at risk. Historical data shows a high case fatality rate associated with central nervous system involvement. Public health officials are urging early medical intervention and strict hygiene practices to control the virus's spread. Vaccination is available and recommended, providing substantial protection against EV71. Notably, Vietnam accounts for over half of global EV71 circulation, with more than 80% of severe cases reported, underscoring the urgent need for effective public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71：高い感染率と重篤な合併症が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。ベトナムは世界的なEV71循環の半分以上を占める重要なエピセンター。
triage.notes: EV71の世界的循環の50%以上がベトナムで報告されており、6歳以下の小児が高リスク。家庭内感染率が60%に達している。神経系合併症による致命率が高く、医療体制の負荷が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensify amid rising hospitalizations
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Brazil is facing a significant increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, with Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) accounting for approximately 19.9% of these cases, particularly impacting infants and children under two years old. The situation is worsened by the emergence of the influenza A (H3N2) variant, leading to heightened hospitalizations and fatalities, especially among the elderly and unvaccinated populations. In 2025, Brazil recorded 3,621 RSV hospitalizations and 68 deaths, with notable cases in Rio Grande do Sul's Serra region. In response, vaccination campaigns are being ramped up through the SUS, targeting vulnerable groups such as seniors, children, and pregnant women. New strategies include the introduction of monoclonal antibodies like Beyfortus for high-risk infants and RSV vaccines for adults. With winter approaching, health authorities emphasize the importance of continued vigilance and vaccination to protect the most susceptible populations from severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの呼吸器合胞体ウイルス（RSV）感染：入院数の増加に伴いワクチン接種活動が強化される
triage.triage_reason: RSVによる重症急性呼吸器疾患の有意な増加、子ども・高齢者を含む脆弱層への著しい影響、複数州での広範囲な流行が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上該当。また社会的・政府的関心も高く、国家規模の対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン、モノクローナル抗体導入等）が進行中である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは監視対象国リストに含まれているため検証対象。記事は複数州（サンパウロ州、リオグランデドスル州、アマパ州、パライバ州）にわたるRSV流行の拡大を報告。冬季の接近に伴う季節的影響が予測されており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow Fever in Brazil: Vaccination efforts ramp up following recent fatalities
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, São Paulo state has reported its first yellow fever death of the year, involving a 38-year-old unvaccinated man from Cunha. In addition to this fatality, two confirmed cases were documented in Cruzeiro, affecting a 23-year-old woman and a 52-year-old man, both of whom have since recovered. Health authorities are treating the death as an isolated incident while enhancing control measures in the affected areas. The yellow fever vaccine remains free and accessible through the Unified Health System (SUS) at local health units. Currently, there is no evidence linking this case to a broader outbreak, and details regarding the source of infection have not been disclosed. Officials emphasize the importance of vaccination to prevent mosquito-borne infections, particularly in forested regions, and urge travelers to immunize before visiting areas where yellow fever vectors are present. This update highlights the ongoing local transmission risk in southeastern Brazil and the critical need for continued vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの黄熱病：最近の死亡者に続くワクチン接種の取り組み強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける黄熱病の死亡事例（1名）と確認症例（2名）が報告され、IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2基準以上）。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡）と流行可能性（ベクター媒介、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）が該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルが含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。ただし、黄熱病はWHO/IHR通知対象疾患であり、死亡事例報告は公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルである。東南ブラジル（São Paulo州）での地域的伝播リスク継続を示唆。記事サマリーでは「孤発例」との記載だが、複数地域（Cunha, Cruzeiro）での事例報告により流行可能性は存在。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Disease in Vietnam: Children at high risk amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Vietnam has reported 24 cases of meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis), resulting in 4 fatalities. Notably, 46% of these cases involve children under 15 years old, with adolescents aged 13-19 exhibiting the highest incidence globally. The disease, which spreads through respiratory droplets, can lead to severe conditions such as meningitis or septicemia, with a case fatality rate of up to 50% without prompt treatment. Even with medical intervention, 10-15% of patients may die, and around 20% of survivors face serious long-term complications. The circulating serogroups include A, B, C, Y, and W. Vaccination is the most effective preventive measure, yet challenges persist due to the co-circulation of other diseases in schools. An 11-year-old girl in Ho Chi Minh City died from fulminant meningococcal meningitis caused by serogroup B, underscoring the urgent need for vaccination and prompt medical care for symptoms such as fever, severe headache, and neck stiffness.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの髄膜炎菌感染症：進行中の流行の中で小児が高リスク状態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡4例・CFR最大50%、国際的懸念：青年層での世界的最高発生率）。WPRO基準でも3つ以上該当（重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌感染症による複数のセログループ（A, B, C, Y, W）が循環中。特に小児および青年層（13-19歳）が高リスク。ホーチミン市では血清群Bによる劇症髄膜炎で11歳女児が死亡。ワクチン接種と迅速な医療介入が急務。記事サマリーはベトナムの進行中の流行に焦点を当てており、verified_locationsはVietnamのみで確認。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Vietnam: Vaccination efforts intensified amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: Vietnam has reported 24 cases of meningococcal meningitis this year, with 46% occurring in children under 15. Outbreaks have been noted in Hanoi, Lao Cai, Ha Tinh, and Phu Quoc, including one fatality. In Ho Chi Minh City, 24 cases were recorded in the first quarter, resulting in 4 deaths. The predominant serogroup in the southern region is B, which accounts for over 98% of cases, particularly affecting young children and youths aged 15-24. The Ministry of Health emphasizes the importance of vaccination and respiratory hygiene to mitigate transmission, especially in crowded settings like schools and daycare centers. Close contacts of confirmed cases are advised to receive post-exposure prophylaxis within 24 hours. The disease can escalate rapidly from flu-like symptoms to severe conditions, with a mortality rate of 8-15% and significant long-term complications for survivors. Health authorities are actively monitoring the situation and implementing control measures to protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：症例増加の中でワクチン接種努力が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な多地域多発、国際的拡大リスク）。小児を含む多数の死亡例、多地域での急速な流行、ワクチン対応。フルRRA進行必要。
triage.notes: 複数の地域（ハノイ、ラオカイ、ハティン、フーコック、ホーチミン市）での同時多発。血清群Bが優勢（98%以上）。小児および青少年（15-24歳）の集団発症。1Q時点でホーチミン市で24例4死亡。致死率8-15%、重篤な長期合併症リスク。保健省によるワクチン接種キャンペーンと曝露後予防投与の実施。

article.articleHeadline: Melioidosis in Thailand: Urgent public health response needed amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of April 16, 2026, Thailand has reported 732 confirmed cases of melioidosis, resulting in 23 deaths this year. The majority of cases are concentrated in Health Region 7 (Khon Kaen), which has recorded 68 cases and 2 fatalities. The disease primarily affects individuals aged 50 and older, particularly those with underlying health conditions such as diabetes and chronic kidney disease. Transmission occurs through contact with contaminated soil or water, inhalation of dust, or ingestion of tainted substances. Symptoms include high fever, respiratory distress, and abscesses, with severe cases potentially leading to septicemia. Authorities recommend preventive measures for high-risk groups, including minimizing contact with soil and water, using protective gear, and seeking medical attention for persistent symptoms. The government stresses the importance of early treatment, which can be curative, and has established a 24/7 hotline for public inquiries.

triage.headline_ja: タイのメリオイドーシス：上昇する症例数の中での緊急の公衆衛生対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。23例の死亡を含む732例の確定患者がタイで報告され、高リスク集団を特定した組織的対応が進行中であり、国際的な監視対象となる。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはBurkholderia pseudomalleíによる土壌・水由来感染症で、東南アジアで風土病。2026年4月16日時点で732確定患者、23死亡は大規模アウトブレイク。タイ政府の組織的対応（24時間ホットライン設置、ガイダンス発出）とWPRO地域での感染症監視対象として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Public health measures intensify amid rising fatalities
article.articleSummary: In the first quarter of 2026, Vietnam reported 12 rabies-related deaths, raising alarms as the peak season approaches. The increase in cases is primarily linked to dog attacks, with significant incidents including a severe attack on a 72-year-old woman in Hai Phong. Tay Ninh province alone recorded seven rabies deaths from January 1 to April 7, 2026, with one victim developing symptoms nearly a year after being bitten. Outbreaks have also been noted in Hanoi, where three separate incidents involved suspected rabid dogs. Experts highlight vaccination gaps in domestic animals as a critical factor, with national vaccination rates hovering around 50%, although some areas exceed 90%. The peak rabies season from May to August is expected to exacerbate risks due to increased dog roaming. Authorities are emphasizing preventive measures such as vaccinating pets, confining them, and ensuring prompt medical care for bite victims. In Quang Ngai, a rabid dog that bit four people has prompted local officials to initiate vaccination campaigns and tighten pet management.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病：死亡者の増加に伴い公衆衛生対策が強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による死亡者が増加し、ピークシーズン前の公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっている。人および動物への影響がある異常なイベントとして、複数のWPRO基準を満たし、国際的な注視が必要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 2026年第1四半期に12件の狂犬病関連死亡が報告され、5月から8月のピークシーズン前に懸念が高まっている。犬の咬傷が主要な感染源であり、国内動物のワクチン接種率が約50%と低いことが重大なリスク要因。Tay Ninh州で7件、Hanoi、Hai Phong、Quang Ngaiで複数の発生が確認されている。ベトナムはWPRO対象国であり、全スクリーニング基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Vietnam: Contaminated pork scandal affects school meal safety
article.articleSummary: In Thai Nguyen province, Vietnam, a scandal involving contaminated pork has led to the arrest of three individuals, including a school principal, in connection with a bribery scheme. The former principal of Nam Hoa Kindergarten, Nguyen Thi Tam, and accountant Tran Thi Hang were detained for accepting bribes from pork supplier Nguyen Van Thanh, who provided meals to schools in Dong Hy District since 2022. Parents raised concerns when pork served at Hoa Binh Kindergarten showed signs of disease, prompting laboratory tests that confirmed the presence of the African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli. Investigators have seized documents and assets related to the case as they expand their inquiry into the source of the infection and potential food safety violations. The situation remains under investigation, with authorities working to ensure the safety of school meal programs.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのアフリカ豚熱病: 汚染された豚肉スキャンダルが学校給食の安全を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱病の確認事例であり、食品安全を含む公衆衛生への影響、異常性、および管理可能性の観点からスクリーニング基準に該当。対象国ベトナムでの検査確認事例として追跡対象。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱病は動物疾病だが、汚染豚肉を通じた食品安全リスクが確認されている。学校給食という公共施設への影響、複数の公式による逮捕・捜査進行中、および食中毒菌（E. coli）の併存検出により公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。ベトナムでの継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Vietnam: Contaminated school meals raise food safety concerns
article.articleSummary: In Thai Nguyen province, Vietnam, a significant food safety scandal has emerged involving contaminated pork supplied to schools. Three individuals, including the principal of Nam Hoa Kindergarten, Nguyen Thi Tam, and accountant Tran Thi Hang, were arrested for accepting bribes from pork supplier Nguyen Van Thanh. This supplier has been under scrutiny since parents reported that the pork served at Hoa Binh Kindergarten showed signs of disease. Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of both the African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli in the meat. The supplier allegedly paid 6% of the contract value monthly to secure meal contracts for the upcoming school year. Investigators have seized documents and assets related to the case, and the inquiry is expanding to uncover the source of the contamination and any broader implications for food safety in school meal programs. This report reflects the latest developments as of April 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのE. coli：汚染された学校給食が食品安全上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 食品安全スキャンダルにおけるE. coli及びアフリカ豚コレラウイルスの検出により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上該当。学校給食という多数の児童への曝露リスク及び社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: タイ・グエン州における複数の幼稚園を対象とした食品汚染事件。アフリカ豚コレラウイルスとE. coliが検出され、贈賄が関与した組織的な食品安全違反が示唆されている。学校給食プログラムへの広範な影響の可能性があり、当局による捜査が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in China: Impact of Zero-Covid policies and recent statistics
article.articleSummary: As of February 14, 2020, China reported 5,090 new COVID-19 infections and 121 additional deaths, totaling 63,851 confirmed cases and 1,380 fatalities. Hubei province accounted for 4,823 new infections and 116 deaths, with recoveries reaching 6,723. Globally, there are approximately 64,434 infections and 1,383 deaths. In response to the outbreak, Hong Kong confirmed three new cases, while Tianjin banned wildlife consumption to curb spread. The healthcare sector faced significant challenges, with over 1,700 medical staff infected and six fatalities. Following the end of the Zero-Covid policy in December 2022, mortality estimates for those aged 65 and older surged, with excess deaths reaching 1.44–2.56 million by the end of 2022. The abrupt lifting of restrictions led to overwhelmed hospitals and a rapid increase in cases, particularly among the elderly, with weekly mortality peaking at 1,030% above baseline before normalizing by February 2023.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のCOVID-19：ゼロコロナ政策の影響と最新統計
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年2月と2022年末の過去イベントの回顧的な統計報告であり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当せず、シグナルトリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年2月14日および2022年末の過去統計の分析であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク検知ではない。配信日時は2026年4月17日と記載されているが、サマリーの内容は遡及的な統計解析に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Severe cases highlight risks of home food storage
article.articleSummary: Recent cases of Listeria monocytogenes in China have raised alarm, particularly among vulnerable populations. A 23-year-old woman in Shenzhen faced severe complications from a refrigerator contamination, requiring extensive medical intervention and resulting in a prolonged ICU stay. Meanwhile, a tragic case involved a 35-year-old pregnant woman in Zhengzhou who contracted listeriosis from eating leftovers, ultimately leading to her death after three months of treatment. The mortality rate for Listeria infections can be as high as 50% in high-risk groups, including pregnant women and the elderly. Symptoms can range from mild gastrointestinal issues to severe conditions like meningitis and septicemia. The bacteria's ability to thrive in refrigerated environments underscores the importance of proper food storage practices. Preventative measures, such as maintaining refrigerator temperatures below 4°C and ensuring safe food handling, are critical to reducing the risk of infection.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のリステリア：家庭での食品保管のリスクを浮き彫りにする重症例
triage.triage_reason: 重症例（ICU入院、妊婦死亡）と高い致死率（高リスク群で50%）が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度、異常性、流行しやすさが該当し、社会的関心も存在するため、フルRRA実施の対象とする。
triage.notes: サマリーでは鄭州（Zhengzhou）と深圳（Shenzhen）での具体的事例が報告されている。鄭州はHenan省に属し、Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに含まれている。妊婦の死亡事例、若年女性のICU入院事例など、重症例が複数報告されており、高リスク人口グループでの致死率が高い点が特に懸念される。食品保管のリスク啓発という観点から社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rubella in Indonesia: Intensified vaccination efforts amid ongoing outbreak
article.articleSummary: A measles outbreak has been declared in Kota Cirebon, Indonesia, following the deaths of two toddlers. The outbreak, identified as KLB (Kejadian Luar Biasa), was announced on February 20, 2026, after an epidemiological assessment revealed its onset in late December 2025, affecting all five districts of the city. In response, local health authorities have initiated mass immunization efforts through Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) targeting children aged 9 months to 13 years, regardless of prior vaccination status. Rapid community surveys are being conducted in collaboration with the Education Department to assess the situation. As of early April 2026, there have been 150 suspected measles cases and 9 laboratory-confirmed cases reported. Although the outbreak trend appears to be waning, the KLB status will remain until there are no new cases for 28 consecutive days. Public health measures continue to focus on vaccination campaigns to control the transmission of both measles and rubella in the region.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおけるはしか：継続的な流行の中での予防接種強化活動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準は5つ全て該当。死亡例を伴う確認済み流行であり、地域内での感染継続が示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事タイトルで『Rubella』と記載されているが、サマリーおよび本文の文脈では『measles（はしか）』が主病態である。インドネシア・チレボン市では2025年12月下旬から流行が開始され、2026年2月20日に正式にKLB（異常事象）として宣言。小児2名の死亡が報告されている。2026年4月初旬時点で150疑い例、9確定例。予防接種強化活動が展開中であり、管理可能性評価では地域レベルでの対応が継続されている。28日間の新規患者ゼロ継続までKLB状態が維持される予定。

article.articleHeadline: Psittacosis in China: Rising cases linked to bird interactions and tourism
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis cases in China have been increasing since 2023, particularly in southern regions. A notable incident in Beijing involved a man who contracted the disease after acquiring a budgerigar from a ring-toss game at a tourist attraction. His 77-year-old father subsequently developed severe pneumonia and required intensive care. The infection, caused by Chlamydia psittaci, is primarily transmitted through aerosols from infected birds, including pigeons and chickens. Symptoms can mimic influenza, leading to potential misdiagnosis, and may progress to severe respiratory issues. Health officials emphasize the importance of prevention strategies, including avoiding contact with live birds, maintaining hygiene, and reporting any poultry exposure. Psittacosis is classified as a Category C notifiable disease in China, necessitating prompt reporting of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のオウム病：鳥との相互作用と観光に関連した症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準で重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が複数該当。社会的関心も高く、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 2023年以降増加傾向を示すオウム病の集積事例。北京での事例では観光地での感染と家族内での重症化が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、観光関連の国際的拡大可能性が懸念される。中国ではCategory C届出疾病に指定されており、公衆衛生当局の対応体制が整備されているが、鳥類との接触が多い地域や観光地における感染リスク管理が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Streptococcus in Vietnam: Health warnings issued for safe pork handling practices
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a 61-year-old man experienced septic shock and multi-organ failure due to a Streptococcus suis infection after handling raw pork. He presented with fever and fatigue, which progressed to severe symptoms, including skin lesions. Blood cultures confirmed the infection, which is commonly transmitted from pigs through skin contact or consumption of undercooked pork. Following 21 days of intensive care and antibiotic treatment, the patient recovered. Health authorities are urging the public to avoid raw or undercooked pork and to wear gloves when handling raw meat, especially for those with skin wounds. Symptoms such as fever, headache, nausea, rash, or hearing loss following exposure to raw pork should prompt immediate medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで連鎖球菌感染症：豚肉の安全な取扱いについて保健当局が警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確でない。ただし、Streptococcus suis感染による重症化事例であり、保健当局が公開警告を発出している点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例（ホーチミン市の61歳男性）の重症化事例に焦点を当てている。Streptococcus suisはブタ由来で既知の病原体であり、この症例自体は異常ではない。保健当局が予防啓発を行っているが、集団発生や複数症例の報告ではなく、現段階では流行の兆候は不明。他の対象国への地理的拡大なし。

article.articleHeadline: Meningoencephalitis in Indonesia: Urgent need for vaccination to prevent severe outcomes
article.articleSummary: In Cirebon, Indonesia, two toddlers have died from complications related to measles, emphasizing the critical risks associated with the disease. Both children exhibited symptoms including fever, shortness of breath, and rash before experiencing rapid clinical decline. One child, referred to as D, deteriorated within hours and passed away approximately one day after being admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) in March. The cause of death was attributed to measles-induced meningoencephalitis, compounded by an underlying congenital heart defect. These tragic cases highlight the urgent need for effective vaccination and public health strategies to mitigate the severe outcomes of measles, particularly in vulnerable populations such as very young children with pre-existing health conditions. The source of infection was confirmed as the measles virus, underscoring the ongoing risk in the region as of April 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの髄膜脳炎：重篤な転帰を防ぐための緊急の予防接種の必要性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。麻疹関連髄膜脳炎による小児死亡2件が確認され、ワクチン対応可能な感染症の死亡事例として重要。インドネシアは対象国。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではCirebon, Jawa Barat内での麻疹関連髄膜脳炎による小児死亡2件が詳細に記述されており、インドネシアでの発生が確認されている。ワクチン予防可能疾患での死亡、先天性心疾患など基礎疾患を持つ脆弱層への影響、急速な臨床的悪化などが特徴。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Philippines: Urgent vaccination needed to protect vulnerable infants
article.articleSummary: As of mid-April 2026, the Philippines is experiencing a notable increase in measles cases, particularly in Quezon City, where 143 infections have been confirmed since January 1. Alarmingly, a significant portion of these cases involves infants who are too young to receive the measles vaccine, highlighting a critical gap in immunity. Health officials have reported that 23 of the affected individuals are ineligible for vaccination, raising concerns about their vulnerability. A recent case involved a 39-year-old unvaccinated woman who contracted measles after traveling abroad, prompting health authorities to identify 187 close contacts, all of whom remain symptom-free. The Center for Health Protection emphasizes the necessity of high vaccination rates to achieve herd immunity and protect those who cannot be vaccinated, particularly infants. The ongoing outbreaks in the region underscore the urgent need for enhanced vaccination efforts to safeguard the health of the community.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンの麻疹：脆弱な乳幼児を保護するための緊急予防接種が必要
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで麻疹の確認症例が143件に増加しており、ヒト-ヒト感染が容易で予防接種が必要な病原体である。IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、国際保健当局の関心が明示されており、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染性を持つウイルス性疾患で、ヒト-ヒト感染が容易である。乳幼児を含む脆弱層が被害を受けており、海外渡航による輸入事例も報告されている。予防接種の必要性が強調されており、公衆衛生当局の対応が進行中と見られる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in India: Containment measures implemented amid confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Bengaluru's Hesaraghatta area, prompting immediate health responses. A containment zone of 3 km has been established, with a 10 km surveillance belt surrounding the outbreak. Approximately 7,444 chickens and 14,788 eggs have been culled to prevent further spread. Ten staff members are currently under medical monitoring. Health workers are set to conduct door-to-door fever surveillance in 19 nearby villages over the next 10 days, focusing on symptoms like fever and cough. Personal protective equipment and essential medicines are available at local health centers. Authorities advise the public to avoid contact with sick or dead birds and to report any sightings to health or veterinary officials. Cooked poultry products remain safe for consumption. As of April 18, 2026, officials emphasize that there is no need for public panic.

triage.headline_ja: インドでの鳥インフルエンザH5N1ヒト感染：確認患者が出ているなか、封じ込め対策が実施されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の人獣共通感染症、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。H5N1ヒト感染確認は高リスクシグナルである。
triage.notes: H5N1ヒト感染例が存在することが記事サマリーで明示されている（'Ten staff members are currently under medical monitoring'）。3km封じ込めゾーン、10km監視帯の設定、7,444羽の鶏および14,788個の卵の殺処分など、積極的な対応が実施されている。カルナタカ州ベンガルール市ヘサラガッタ地区での発生確認。これは直ちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要な高優先度シグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Health officials warn of potential resurgence
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) remains a significant health concern in Vietnam, with recent reports indicating that it accounts for over half of all enterovirus infections and the majority of severe cases. The virus, known for its potential to cause severe neurological complications, has a fatality rate of up to 20% in critical cases. Recent incidents include a tragic case involving two-year-old twins, where one child succumbed shortly after hospital admission. Health authorities emphasize the importance of vaccination for children under six years old as a preventive measure. The virus's fecal-oral transmission can persist for over three months, complicating control efforts. Asymptomatic carriers among adults contribute to the hidden spread of EV71, necessitating ongoing public health education and awareness campaigns to mitigate risks.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのエンテロウイルス71：保健当局が潜在的な再燃を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な状況、国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（高い重症度・致命率、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ、管理課題）。致死率20%、神経合併症、無症状キャリアによる隠れた感染など多層的リスク。
triage.notes: エンテロウイルス71は東南アジアで周期的に再燃する重要な病原体。フィリピン・タイでも過去に大規模流行経歴あり。致死率20%、神経合併症、3ヶ月以上の便排泄による長期感染源化、無症状キャリアなどが管理困難性を高める。小児（6歳未満）への予防接種が推奨されている点から、現在の対応が既に課題化していることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Strengthened vaccination and surveillance initiatives underway
article.articleSummary: As of April 18, 2026, Indonesia is intensifying measles surveillance and vaccination efforts in response to increasing cases. In West Sulawesi, health officials are enhancing epidemiological investigations to quickly identify and manage outbreaks, focusing on early detection and response to Extraordinary Events (KLB) of measles. The province is prioritizing immunization and healthcare improvements to protect future generations. The World Health Organization (WHO) is supporting these public health initiatives, aiding in outbreak investigations and vaccination campaigns. In East Java's Sumenep, a recent outbreak was contained after approximately 3,000 suspected cases were reported, with 205 confirmed cases by August 2025, following a successful immunization campaign that achieved 96.1% vaccine coverage. Additionally, a KLB of measles has been declared across seven regions in South Sulawesi, highlighting the urgent need for coordinated public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹：ワクチン接種と監視活動の強化が進行中
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹の複数地域での集団発生（KLB）が確認され、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」の2項目、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常・予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」の複数項目に該当。WHOも支援に関与している。
triage.notes: 複数地域での麻疹KLB宣言（南スラウェシ7地域、西スラウェシ）、スメネップ地域では2025年8月までに確認患者205例の実績あり。WHOが公式支援。ワクチン接種率96.1%達成実績あるも継続的な対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Ongoing transmission prompts urgent prevention measures
article.articleSummary: Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, is experiencing significant chikungunya activity, with 82 confirmed cases and 297 notifications reported in the latest epidemiological bulletin dated April 16. Additionally, there has been one death attributed to the virus. The city is also monitoring dengue, with 4 confirmed cases and 297 notifications, but no fatalities. Local health authorities are actively responding to the situation by implementing integrated vector-control strategies, including house-to-house visits to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. A citywide cleanup campaign is underway to address waste and potential larval habitats, while health education initiatives in schools aim to raise awareness. Public information campaigns are being disseminated through radio and social media to inform residents about prevention measures. A second cycle of fumacê insecticide fogging is planned, and residents are advised to keep doors and windows open during applications and to eliminate standing water around their homes.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア熱：継続的な伝播が緊急予防措置を促す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の顕著な活動（82確定例、1死亡）と継続的な伝播が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常性」と「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」の2基準を満たすシグナルとして識別される。ベクター媒介感染症の国際的な拡大リスクも考慮される。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的に地域別症例数（82確定例、1死亡）と検査通知数（297件）を報告しており、地元保健当局が統合的蚊媒介対策を実施中。ベクター媒介感染症であるため、継続的な人間への曝露と流行しやすさのリスクが明確。IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では5項目中4項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in China: Recent exposure highlights ongoing public health concerns
article.articleSummary: On April 8-9, 2026, a traveler at Hyatt Place Chengdu in Sichuan encountered a bat in his hotel room, resulting in a Category III rabies exposure after sustaining a wound on his arm. The individual received extensive post-exposure prophylaxis, including 11 injections of rabies vaccine, rabies immunoglobulin, and a tetanus vaccine, totaling a medical cost of 1,630.5 yuan. The hotel attributed the bat's presence to incidental wildlife intrusion and engaged a third-party team for investigation, which found no abnormal conditions. Despite initial reluctance to cover medical expenses, the hotel later reimbursed the traveler and offered additional compensation. The Chengdu CDC confirmed the exposure level and emphasized the importance of rapid treatment, noting that bats can carry various pathogens, although testing capabilities remain limited.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でのペストコントロール：最近の露出は継続的な公衆衛生の懸念を浮き彫りにしている
triage.triage_reason: 中国四川省の単一の旅行者による限定的なCategory III狂犬病露出事例。予想外の野生動物侵入であるが、個人例であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報不足が多く経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一の旅行者のホテル内での動物露出事例。狂犬病は致死的であるが、この事例は曝露段階で適切な治療を受けており、確定症例ではない。コウモリの病原体保有リスクについて言及されているが、検査能力の制限が指摘されている。中国（香港・マカオ含む）は対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Tetanus in Vietnam: Vaccination efforts crucial during peak transmission season
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, the risk of rabies has escalated during the hot season, with 12 reported deaths in the first quarter of 2026. Notably, Tay Ninh recorded seven rabies fatalities from January 1 to April 7, including a case that developed symptoms nearly a year post-bite. In Hai Phong, a 72-year-old woman was severely injured by a dog and received immediate medical intervention, including rabies immunoglobulin and tetanus vaccination. The country is experiencing multiple dog-associated outbreaks, particularly in Hanoi, where three incidents were reported in the Hoa Lac and Ha Bang areas. Experts highlight significant vaccination gaps in domestic animals, with a national average of around 50%, which exacerbates the risk during the rabies season from May to August. To mitigate the threat, authorities emphasize the importance of vaccinating pets, confining them, and ensuring prompt medical care for those exposed to potential rabies.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの破傷風：ピーク伝播期間におけるワクチン接種の重要性
triage.triage_reason: 記事サマリーの主題は狂犬病（rabies）であり、見出しと疾患名（Tetanus）に不一致がある。ベトナムでの狂犬病発生は該当国であるが、見出しと内容の齟齬により情報の信頼性が低く、詳細な検証が必要。
triage.notes: 重大な矛盾を指摘：疾患名は『破傷風（Tetanus）』だが、記事サマリーの主題は『狂犬病（rabies）』である。見出しは破傷風を言及しているが、本文は狂犬病に関する内容。ベトナムは対象国であり、狂犬病による死亡（12名）や動物咬傷関連の複数件の発生は重症度・流行性の基準に該当するが、データの正確性を確認する必要がある。見出しと本文の乖離により、情報源の検証を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Ongoing vector control and public health initiatives
article.articleSummary: Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, is experiencing active transmission of Aedes aegypti-borne diseases, with recent reports indicating 82 confirmed chikungunya cases and 4 confirmed dengue cases, alongside 297 notifications for both diseases. No deaths have been reported from dengue, while chikungunya has resulted in one fatality. Local health authorities are implementing integrated vector-control strategies, including house-to-house visits to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and a citywide cleanup campaign to reduce waste. Public health education efforts are being enhanced through school programs and information campaigns via radio and social media. Additionally, a second cycle of fumacê insecticide fogging is planned, urging residents to take precautions by keeping doors and windows open during applications and removing standing water to mitigate mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：継続的なベクター対策と公衆衛生イニシアティブ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱・チクングニア熱の局所的な発生が報告されているが、死亡例がなく現在の規模は限定的。スクリーニング基準複数該当だが、国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響の証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: イベントは記事サマリーでブラジル（Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul）で確認されている。デング熱は4件、チクングニア熱は82件の確認例がある。死亡例はデング熱ではなくチクングニア熱のみ（1件）。地域的な対応が進行中であり、現在のところ国家・国際レベルの危機対応の兆候は見られない。WPRスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、情報不足と限定的な影響規模により、フル評価前に続報の注視が適切と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: First cluster reported amid rising health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Vietnam's Ha Tinh Province has reported its first dengue fever cluster in Vung Ang ward, with 19 confirmed cases. The initial patient, presenting with high fever and severe symptoms, was admitted to the local hospital, prompting immediate public health interventions. Local health authorities, including the Ha Tinh CDC, initiated mosquito control measures, including two rounds of spraying and enhanced community surveillance to prevent further spread. In total, the province has recorded 32 dengue cases this year, with one outbreak and the remainder being import-related. The recent warm weather conditions are raising concerns about increased transmission rates. A dengue vaccine, licensed in May 2024, is available, but vaccination should be conducted under medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：懸念の高まりの中で初のクラスターが報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。ベトナムでのデング熱クラスター発生は地域で重要な公衆衛生シグナルであり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムのハティン省ブンアン地区で2026年4月17日時点で初のデング熱クラスター（確認患者19人）が報告された。同省では年間32例を記録し、温暖な気候条件が感染率上昇の懸念要因。地方保健当局による蚊対策とサーベイランスが実施中。2024年5月にライセンス取得したデング熱ワクチンが利用可能。対象国リストに基づきベトナムのみを検証地域として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) in Brazil: Health emergency declared amid rising ICU occupancy
article.articleSummary: Goiás, Brazil, has declared a health emergency due to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) as ICU occupancy rates increase. The state government has established the Center of Health Emergency Operations for SARS (Coe-Srag) to coordinate the response, which includes emergency procurement of health supplies and hiring temporary staff. As of 2026, there have been 2,560 reported cases of SARS-related illness (Srag), a decrease from 2,909 cases in the same period in 2025. However, influenza vaccination coverage remains critically low at 8.69%, with only about 115,000 doses administered to priority groups. Public health measures are being implemented to enhance diagnosis and manage the outbreak effectively.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの重症急性呼吸器症候群（SARS）：ICU占有率上昇の中で保健緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはブラジルのゴイアス州で報告されており、対象国リストに該当しない。また記事内容から見ると2025年比で症例数が減少しており、深刻度は限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域はブラジル（ゴイアス州）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、地理的リスク評価の観点からは南米での限定的な発生であり、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Human Metapneumovirus Infection in India: First confirmed case reported with no immediate spread
article.articleSummary: The first confirmed case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Maharashtra for 2026 was reported on March 30, involving a seven-month-old boy from Washim. He was admitted to AIIMS Nagpur and has since recovered, with PCR confirmation of the virus. This case marks the state's initial confirmation of HMPV this year, following only a few sporadic suspected cases. HMPV, a respiratory virus related to RSV and parainfluenza, poses risks primarily to young children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. Testing of five close family contacts returned negative results, indicating no immediate household transmission. Surveillance by the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) shows no unusual increase in influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) in the region, and health authorities are actively monitoring the Washim area for any further developments.

triage.headline_ja: インドのヒトメタニューモウイルス感染症：確認された最初の症例、直後の拡大は報告されていない
triage.triage_reason: インド（マハラシュトラ州）で2026年初のHMPV確認症例が報告されているが、患者は回復し、濃厚接触者5名は陰性で家庭内伝播の証拠がなく、地域の異常な疾患増加も認められていない。情報が散発的であり、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: HMPVは乳幼児・高齢者・免疫不全者への高リスク病原体であり、散発性だが呼吸器感染症として監視対象。現時点では局所的かつ孤発症例であり、家庭内伝播なく地域の疾病負荷増加も認められていない。IDSPによる継続監視中。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2 in Brazil: Recent cases and vaccination efforts reported
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Brazil's Federal District confirmed six cases of influenza K (H3N2), including a fatality involving a 17-year-old girl. During epidemiological week 14 (April 5–11), the district reported 1,627 Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases, with 67 attributed to influenza, of which six were H3N2. Goiás State also reported three mild cases in Caldas Novas, Anápolis, and Itumbiara, all of which have recovered. The seasonal increase in cases aligns with the March–April period, prompting a vaccination campaign that began on March 25, achieving over 100,000 doses administered. Vaccination coverage stands at 23% for the elderly, 19.5% for pregnant women, and 10% for children aged 6 months to under 6 years. The Pan American Health Organization/World Health Organization (PAHO/WHO) has issued alerts regarding influenza K following cases in Europe, with Brazil's first reported case occurring in Pará in December. Influenza A remains the predominant circulating virus, and influenza K presents flu-like symptoms without increased transmissibility or severity.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるヒトブタインフルエンザA H3N2感染：最近の症例と予防接種の取り組みが報告される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるH3N2インフルエンザの確認症例と死亡例が報告されているが、重症度は中程度、国際的拡大リスクは現時点で不明確。情報がやや不完全な段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ以上該当（深刻な影響あり、異常/予想外）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も3つ該当している。死亡例の報告と複数州での確認により重要性は認められるが、H3N2は既知の呼吸器ウイルスであり増加する伝播性や重症度は報告されていない。PAHO/WHOアラートあり。対象国はBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in China: Market turmoil as virus impacts pig farming
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) is rapidly spreading across China, with reports indicating that the virus has mutated, leading to the death of infected pigs within approximately three days. Key regions affected include Hebei, Shandong, Liaoning, Yunnan, Jiangxi, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian. The situation has resulted in a significant collapse of live pig prices, with standard pigs weighing around 110 kg selling for less than 4 yuan per jin, and some stalls offering prices as low as 2 yuan per jin, which is cheaper than vegetables. Authorities are allegedly suppressing information regarding the outbreak, and many infected pigs have entered markets without proper disposal. External purchases of piglets show an alarming infection rate of up to 80%, while self-reared pigs, although considered safer, may still carry asymptomatic infections. A slaughterhouse owner in Beijing has confirmed that ASF is present nationwide, echoing concerns from the 2019 outbreak when prices soared to about 40 yuan per kg. Currently, supply exceeds demand, with market manipulation by groups seeking short-term profits.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）が中国で急速に拡大、ウイルスが豚農業に影響を与え市場が混乱
triage.triage_reason: ASFは中国全土の複数地域で急速に拡大し、養豚産業に重大な経済的影響を与えている。感染率が高く（外部購入豚で80%）、当局が情報を抑制している報告もあり、IHR基準の「異常性」「重大な影響」に該当する。動物感染症であるが、食料安全保障と市場の安定性に関わる重大なイベント。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病だが、中国の食料安全保障と農業経済に深刻な影響を与えている。2019年のアウトブレイク経験がある。当局による情報抑制と市場への感染豚の流入が報告されている。国内での広範な拡大（河北、山東、遼寧、雲南、江西、広東、広西、福建）が確認されており、ウイルス変異の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in India: School exams delayed due to outbreak in Karnataka
article.articleSummary: In Somwarpet, Karnataka, a varicella outbreak has affected over 30 students at a private school, prompting the postponement of exams. Parents have expressed concerns over the lack of adequate pediatric care at the local government hospital, which currently does not have a permanent pediatrician. Pediatricians from Madikeri visit only once a week, limiting access to care. Additionally, shortages of anesthesiologists and radiologists have forced families to seek treatment at private facilities, imposing financial strain on lower-income households. Local residents are advocating for the immediate appointment of a permanent pediatric specialist to address these healthcare gaps. Hospital administrator Dr. Jameer Ahmed confirmed that treatment for chickenpox is available, with a typical recovery period of two weeks, although skin marks may take up to six months to fade.

triage.headline_ja: インド水痘：カルナータカ州での流行により学校試験が遅延
triage.triage_reason: 水痘の局所的な集団発生（30名以上の学生）が確認されており、IHR基準では2つ未満の該当、WPRO基準では異常性と管理可能性の懸念が認識される。ただし国際的拡大リスク、重症度の明記がなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカルナータカ州ソムワルペットの私立学校での水痘集団発生。医療インフラの問題（小児科医の不足、専門医のアクセス制限）が強調されており、ローカルな医療管理可能性の課題が存在する。水痘は対象国インドで発生しており、verified_locationsに含める。重症度や死亡の記載がないため、IHR基準での「serious_impact」はNo。ただし学校閉鎖、試験延期などの社会的影響と、医療アクセスの問題から管理可能性に懸念があり、WPRO基準では4項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in China
article.articleSummary: China has reported its first documented human infections from the Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), previously associated only with marine life. A study involving 70 patients diagnosed between 2022 and 2025 revealed that all had confirmed infections, with disease severity ranging from moderate to severe. Approximately one-third of these patients required surgical intervention, and one individual suffered blindness. Notably, some cases arose without direct water exposure, suggesting potential human-to-human transmission, although this has not been confirmed. The virus is prevalent in marine environments across multiple continents and affects various marine species.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における正体不明の感染症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：中等度～重症例、手術・失明事例；予想外：海洋生物のみからの人間感染報告；国際的拡大リスク：複数大陸の海洋環境で流行；渡航・貿易制限リスク：潜在的ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV)は未知の病原体で、2022-2025年の70症例が文献化されている。中等度～重症例が報告され、約1/3が手術、失明事例も存在。水への直接接触なしでの感染報告があり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が懸念される。複数大陸の海洋環境での流行が確認されており、国際的な脅威となる可能性が高い。詳細な疫学情報と感染経路の確認が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Brazil: Public health strategies aim to curb transmission
article.articleSummary: Brazil continues to experience significant tuberculosis activity, primarily transmitted through airborne droplets in poorly ventilated spaces. The disease, caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, presents early warning signs such as evening fever, night sweats, and unintentional weight loss. Without timely intervention, it can lead to severe pulmonary and pleural complications. Many cases go undiagnosed due to delays in seeking care, which perpetuates community transmission. The public health system (SUS) employs sputum smear testing for acid-fast bacilli (BAAR) as a cost-effective and accessible diagnostic method. Treatment is provided free of charge nationwide, starting immediately after diagnosis with a six-month multi-drug regimen and regular follow-ups. However, treatment abandonment poses a significant challenge, leading to relapses and ongoing transmission. Dr. Leandro Baptista emphasizes the necessity of rapid diagnosis, effective treatment, and patient adherence to disrupt the cycle of transmission and safeguard public health. This discussion coincides with World TB Day, underscoring the critical need for awareness and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの結核：公衆衛生戦略が感染予防を目指す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの結核活動は継続的であり、公衆衛生的課題（診断遅延、治療中断）が存在するが、新規発生や異常な拡大を示す具体的な証拠がない。World TB Day関連の啓発記事と考えられ、既知疾患への対応状況の報告。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld TB Dayに関連した公衆衛生啓発・情報提供であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。結核は既知の風土病であり、ブラジルの公衆衛生システム（SUS）が診断・治療を提供している。診断遅延や治療中断が課題だが、これは既知の構造的問題である。続報があれば耐性菌株の出現や急激な増加のような新たな発展に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: HIV in Philippines: Youth transmission remains a critical concern
article.articleSummary: In Q4 2025, the Philippines reported 4,277 new HIV cases, predominantly among males (4,038) and significantly affecting youth aged 15-24, who accounted for 32% of cases. The total cumulative cases since 1984 have reached 163,454. Although there was a decline from Q3 2025's 5,583 cases, the average of 47 new cases per day indicates ongoing challenges. Alarmingly, there has been a 500% increase in new infections among individuals aged 15-25 in early 2025, highlighting a critical public health issue. The Department of Health (DOH) noted that 1,069 individuals had advanced HIV disease by the end of the quarter. Current treatment targets show 61% diagnosed, 66% on treatment, and 57% virally suppressed, with projections suggesting over 457,000 cases by 2030 if trends continue. The uptake of Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) has seen 4,760 new enrollees, but the situation remains dire, particularly for the youth demographic.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのHIV: 若年層の感染が依然として重大な懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性（若年層での500%増加）、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。若年層感染の急増と管理能力の懸念により、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 2025年Q4に4,277件の新規HIV診断が報告され、若年層（15-24歳）が症例の32%を占める。特に2025年初頭の15-25歳での500%の感染増加は異常かつ懸念される。2030年までに457,000件を超える見込みであり、治療目標達成率（診断61%、治療中66%、ウイルス抑制57%）は不十分。フィリピンの公式保健機関（DOH）による報告であり、政府関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in India: Community efforts enhance malaria prevention and treatment
article.articleSummary: In Gundijoda village, West Singhbhum district, Jharkhand, a malaria testing campaign revealed two positive cases during a house-to-house screening conducted by the Health Department and CINI Foundation. The initiative, aimed at curbing malaria transmission, involved local health workers educating residents on symptoms such as fever, chills, and body aches, as well as preventive measures like using mosquito nets and maintaining clean environments. Prompt antimalarial treatment was administered to the affected individuals, with health workers ensuring adherence to therapy. This campaign highlights the importance of community engagement in early case detection and prevention strategies to mitigate the risk of malaria outbreaks in remote rural areas.

triage.headline_ja: インドのマラリア：コミュニティの取り組みがマラリア予防と治療を強化
triage.triage_reason: ジャルカンド州West Singhbhum地区の村での限定的な症例検出（2例）であり、組織的な検査キャンペーンの一部。IHR基準は該当せず、スクリーニング基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: インドではマラリアは地域的に常在する疾患であり、2例の検出は予防キャンペーンの成功を示す。死亡、入院患者の報告なし。地域限定的な症例であり、異常な拡大傾向なし。ルーチンな予防活動の報道として分類。

article.articleHeadline: Glanders in India: Regulatory changes ease restrictions on equine movement
article.articleSummary: A recent outbreak of Glanders at the Bengaluru Turf Club (BTC) led to the area being designated as a 'notified area' under the National Action Plan for Control and Eradication of Glanders. However, as of April 17, 2026, the area has been de-notified, allowing for the immediate withdrawal of movement restrictions on equines, donkeys, and mules. This decision marks a significant step towards normalizing operations at BTC and among stakeholders, indicating successful containment of the outbreak. The report does not provide specific details on case counts, deaths, or ongoing surveillance, nor does it address the movement of animals beyond the de-notified zone. The action reflects adherence to national guidelines aimed at restoring animal movement while ensuring continued monitoring of the situation.

triage.headline_ja: インドのグランダース：馬匹移動制限の緩和に関する規制変更
triage.triage_reason: グランダースの発生地域が既に解除され、制限措置が撤廃された事後報道である。国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性が認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年4月17日の時点で既にグランダースの発生地域が『de-notified』（解除）されたことを報告しているもので、現在進行中の危機ではなく、制限措置解除の事後報道である。ケース数、死亡数、継続中の監視に関する詳細情報がない。動物疾病であり、ヒト感染リスクに関する記載もない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Encephalitis in Indonesia: Outbreak strains healthcare amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: In Kota Cirebon, Indonesia, a measles outbreak has led to the deaths of two toddlers under two years old, both suffering from congenital heart disease and severe malnutrition. The local hospital, RS Gunung Jati Cirebon, is currently overwhelmed, reporting four additional critical measles patients and numerous others with high fever, dehydration, pneumonia, otitis, and potential encephalitis. Since declaring a measles outbreak in February 2026, the region has seen a significant increase in cases, with 238 suspected and 44 confirmed in 2025, and by April 4, 2026, 150 suspected and 9 confirmed cases. The highest incidence is noted in Argasunya and Kalijaga, primarily affecting children aged 1–4 years and adults over 15. Symptoms include fever, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and rash. Health authorities are urging isolation and vaccination, with recommendations for screening children aged 9 months to 15 years and lab confirmation through the health department.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの原因不明脳炎：症例増加に伴う医療逼迫
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生に伴う死亡例と重症患者の増加、医療施設の逼迫が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）と WPRO 基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは『Unknown Encephalitis』と記載されているが、本文の内容は麻疹（measles）の集団発生が主題である。死亡例（2名の乳幼児）、重症患者の増加、医療施設の負荷が確認されている。2月に集団発生を宣言以降、4月4日時点で疑い150例、確定9例と報告されている。脳炎は麻疹の合併症として言及されている可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza in Brazil: Monitoring and response efforts continue in affected areas
article.articleSummary: As of April 16, 2026, the Taim Ecological Station in Santa Vitória do Palmar, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, has reopened following a 28-day closure due to a high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 outbreak. The closure was initiated on March 3 after the detection of the virus in Coscoroba coscoroba swans at Lagoa da Mangueira. During this period, extensive wildlife surveillance was conducted, including 95 farm inspections within a 10 km radius of the outbreak site and 22 inspections of regional poultry farms to ensure compliance with biosafety measures. Despite the reopening, the Taim area remains a permanent risk zone due to migratory bird traffic, and authorities continue to advise the public against approaching sick or dead animals. Residents and visitors are encouraged to report any suspected cases to the Agropecuária Defense Inspectorate.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるヒト鳥インフルエンザ感染：影響地域での監視と対応努力の継続
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザH5N1の動物感染（白鳥）の検出と野生動物サーベイランスが報告されているが、記事サマリーではヒト感染の具体的事例が明記されていない。見出しはヒト感染を示唆するが、本文はあくまで動物での検出と再開決定に焦点。情報が不十分であり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事見出しは『Human Infection with Avian Influenza』を示唆するが、サマリー本文では白鳥（Coscoroba coscoroba）での検出のみ記載され、ヒト感染の確認は不明。H5N1の高病原性株が確認されたこと、渡航性鳥類による継続的リスクがあること、複数地域での検査が実施されたことはスクリーニング基準を満たす。続報でヒト感染の有無を確認必要。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1 in Brazil: Preventive measures and vaccination campaigns underway
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza A continues to circulate in Brazil, primarily transmitted through respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, cough, malaise, chills, myalgia, and nasal discharge, with severe cases requiring oseltamivir phosphate treatment within 48 hours. The Brazilian health system (SUS) is implementing an annual vaccination campaign from March 28 to May, utilizing a trivalent vaccine that protects against H1N1, H3N2, and Influenza B, targeting vulnerable populations such as the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and healthcare workers. Private clinics also offer a quadrivalent vaccine. In addition to vaccination, public health measures emphasize hand hygiene, mask-wearing, proper ventilation, and avoiding crowded places to mitigate the spread of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるヒトの豚インフルエンザA型H1N1感染：予防措置とワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中
triage.triage_reason: H1N1はブラジルで既知・定着した呼吸器感染症であり、異常性や予想外性に乏しい。記事は予防キャンペーン・ワクチン接種の実施状況を述べるルーチン情報であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当性が低い。
triage.notes: H1N1はブラジルで季節性インフルエンザとして定着しており、記事は年次ワクチン接種キャンペーン（3月28日～5月）の実施に関するルーチン的な公衆衛生情報である。新規発生、異常なクラスタ、重症度の上昇、管理能力の欠如などの兆候は認められない。
